**Job role:**

**Department:** 
 Operation

**Location:**

**About The Hosteller** 




  





 The Hosteller is a people\-first backpacker hostel brand built around travel, community, and shared experiences. We create spaces where travellers from across the world connect, stories are exchanged, and memories are made. Powered by passionate teams on\-ground and at the corporate level, The Hosteller values ownership, empathy, collaboration and a deep respect for both people and places.
 



  





 At The Hosteller, you’ll be part of a fast\-growing, entrepreneurial environment where ideas matter, ownership is encouraged and growth is real. We offer hands\-on exposure, opportunities to learn across functions and the chance to build meaningful experiences for both travellers and teammates\-every single day.
 



  





**Role overview** 




  





 The Area operations manager shall be responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day operations, performance, and compliance of multiple properties/units within an assigned geographic area (1000\-1500 beds in an area). This role ensures consistent service quality, operational efficiency, cost control, and team performance, while acting as the key link between on\-ground teams and central leadership. His/her role shall involve overseeing multiple facets of hotel operations such as staffing, hiring, guest experience, day\-to\-day operations, repairs/maintenance, P\&L, etc., centrally and as per the company's standard operating procedures
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Understanding of the hospitality/hotel industry, various functions in the sector including front office, housekeeping, F\&B, concierge along with departmental knowledge across human resource (both white \& blue collar) requirements, vendor management, guest relations, housekeeping, R\&M, etc.
* Oversee end\-to\-end operations across multiple properties / units in the assigned area including work areas as: licensing \& compliances, owner\-tenant relationship management, P\&L management \& optimisation, maintenance \& upkeep, crisis management, etc.
* Ensure brand standards, SOPs, safety norms and guest experience benchmarks are consistently met
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective actions proactively
* Lead, mentor and manage a high performing, disciplined, trained and effective hotel/hostel level team with adherence to the company culture
* Support hiring, onboarding, and retention of on\-ground teams
* Monitor property\-level P\&Ls, costs, and operational budgets along with controlling wastage, shrinkage and inefficiencies across properties
* Ensure compliance with statutory norms, licenses, audits, and safety standards and liaise with various departments such as local police, health/fire/safety departments, local vendors, etc. and ensuring a cordial relationship
* Oversee preventive maintenance, asset upkeep, and vendor performance
* Ensure properties are audit\-ready at all times
* Act as the primary interface between central teams (operations, HR, finance, supply chain, marketing) and on\-ground teams
* Coordinate with vendors, local authorities, and partners when required
* Support new property launches (pre\-ops), stabilisation and scale\-up efforts
* Monitor guest feedback, reviews, and NPS across properties
* Lead resolution of escalated guest issues and service failures
* Drive continuous improvement in guest experience and community engagement



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in Hotel management, Hospitality administration, Operations management, or Business administration
* Postgraduate qualification (MBA/PGDM in Operations, Hospitality, or Tourism) preferred
* 7\+ years of experience in multi\-unit hospitality or service operations (hotels, hostels, resorts)
* Minimum 2–3 years in a supervisory/area/cluster operations role managing multiple properties
* Experience in new property launches, stabilisation, or turnaround will be an added advantage
* Hands\-on experience with Property Management Systems (PMS) such as eZee Absolute, Opera, IDS, RMS, Stayflexi, or similar platforms
* Practical working knowledge of Online Travel Agencies (OTAs) including Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, Goibibo, Agoda, Expedia, Airbnb, etc.
* Exposure to revenue management tools, dashboards, and MIS reporting systems
* Solid understanding of hotel P\&L structures, cost controls, budgeting, and variance analysis
* Experience managing operational KPIs such as occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, GOP, guest satisfaction scores, and audit ratings
* Knowledge of statutory compliance, safety standards, and operational audits
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to interpret operational and revenue data
* Proven people leadership and performance management capabilities
* Willingness to travel extensively across assigned locations
* Language knowledge \- Hindi, English, Marathi, Kannada, Telugu, Malayalam, etc.

 read here

title: Vessel Manager
description:

**Job Purpose:** 
 Executive \- Building Management Systems (BMS) is responsible for overseeing the engineering, maintenance, and operational management of all BMS systems within the airport. This includes ensuring the proper functioning, reliability, and performance of systems such as HVAC, lighting, fire alarm systems, access control, and other integrated mechanical, electrical, and civil systems that are controlled through BMS. The role ensures preventive and corrective maintenance, and manage troubleshooting for BMS\-related issues across airport facilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**BMS System Engineering \& Maintenance:**
 Lead the engineering, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of BMS systems, ensuring that they operate efficiently, reliably, and in compliance with airport standards.
   

  

 Oversee the day\-to\-day operation of BMS infrastructure, including HVAC, lighting, electrical systems, fire alarm systems, and access controls, ensuring their seamless integration with other airport systems.
   

  

 Ensure continuous monitoring, testing, and updating of BMS systems to maintain optimal performance levels across all facilities.
   

  

 Develop and execute maintenance schedules for BMS systems, ensuring proper preventive maintenance and minimal downtime.
   

  

**Troubleshooting And Fault Resolution**
 Lead troubleshooting efforts in case of system failures, quickly diagnosing faults within BMS\-related systems and resolving issues with minimal disruption to airport operations.
   

  

 Coordinate with engineering teams to repair or replace faulty components of BMS systems, ensuring efficient and timely resolutions.
   

  

 Implement diagnostic tools and technologies to identify potential issues before they impact the operations of the airport.
   

  

**Energy Efficiency And Sustainability**
 Monitor and optimize energy consumption across airport facilities by utilizing BMS for HVAC systems, lighting, and electrical load management.
   

  

 Implement energy\-saving initiatives through BMS systems, ensuring energy optimization and contributing to the airport’s sustainability goals.
   

  

 Evaluate the performance of BMS systems in managing energy usage, recommending improvements for greater cost savings and environmental benefits.
   

  

**Safety And Regulatory Compliance**
 Ensure that all BMS systems comply with airport\-specific safety standards, industry regulations, and local environmental health and safety guidelines.
   

  

 Conduct regular safety audits and inspections on BMS\-related systems, ensuring proper documentation and compliance with safety standards such as fire safety, electrical safety, and hazard control.
   

  

 Assist in the development and updating of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for BMS operation and maintenance to ensure a safe environment for all stakeholders.
   

  

**Budget Planning \& Forecasting**
 Develop and manage the annual budget for BMS operations, including system maintenance, upgrades, energy\-saving initiatives, and staffing.
   

  

 Prepare detailed budget forecasts, considering historical data, upcoming projects, and planned system enhancements to ensure adequate financial planning.
   

  

**BMS Performance Monitoring**
 Lead the monitoring of BMS data for system performance, energy usage, and operational efficiency, utilizing system dashboards and reports.
   

  

 Analyze system data to detect performance trends and inefficiencies, implementing corrective measures as necessary.
   

  

 Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) related to BMS system uptime, reliability, and energy consumption to ensure continuous improvement.
   

  

**Vendor And Contractor Management**
 Oversee relationships with third\-party vendors and contractors responsible for BMS system components or services, ensuring high\-quality service delivery and compliance with contractual obligations.
   

  

 Coordinate with vendors for the timely procurement of equipment, materials, and parts required for the maintenance and repair of BMS systems.
   

  

 Manage vendor service level agreements (SLAs) and ensure that maintenance and repair activities are performed within specified time frames and quality standards.
   

  

**Team Leadership And Development**
 Lead and supervise the BMS engineering and maintenance team, providing guidance, training, and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
   

  

 Develop and implement training programs to improve the technical skills and knowledge of the BMS team.
   

  

 Ensure proper documentation of maintenance activities and work orders, ensuring that team members follow industry best practices and safety guidelines.
   

  

**Project Management And System Upgrades**
 Lead BMS system upgrade projects, including design, installation, and commissioning, ensuring alignment with airport’s engineering objectives and timelines.
   

  

 Plan and manage engineering projects related to BMS integration with other airport systems, ensuring minimal disruption to ongoing operations during implementation.
   

  

 Assist in evaluating and selecting new BMS technologies and tools to enhance operational capabilities.
   

  

**Reporting And Documentation**
 Provide regular reports on the status and performance of BMS systems, including energy usage, maintenance activities, and system health.
   

  

 Maintain detailed records of system configurations, maintenance logs, troubleshooting reports, and compliance audits to ensure transparency and accountability.
   

  

 Document system updates, troubleshooting efforts, and any changes to BMS configurations, ensuring all data is current and easily accessible for future reference.
